speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that detailed description. To help narrow down the cause, can you tell me how long each episode of spinning lasts—does it resolve within a minute, or does it persist for much longer?

text: Does the spinning sensation typically last for less than one minute, or does it persist for hours or days? Also, do you experience any ringing in your ears or a feeling of fullness in one ear?

text: Past medical history: No significant past medical or surgical history. No history of Meniere's disease, vestibular neuritis, or labyrinthitis. Social history: Retired school teacher. Lives alone. Non-smoker, occasional wine. Enjoys light gardening.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that history. speaker: Patient

speaker: Doctor
text:
The brief duration of symptoms and their trigger by head movement strongly suggest Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV). I will now perform a physical exam to confirm this diagnosis.
